# FLUX

> Drop-in LLM cost reduction billed as a percentage of verified savings.
> Savings are measured per completed task with quality held, from the
> provider's own reported usage, and every invoice is recomputable by the
> customer from a hash-chained event ledger. Figures are per traffic segment
> (one number would be wrong for most customers), currently simulator-measured
> at providers' published prices: async/batch 57.7% net, one-shot templated
> 45.5-72.8%, interactive agents 25.9-34.0%, already-optimised stacks 0-5%
> with an explicit do-not-pay-us verdict.
